title: Agent Authorization Credential
description: Sigil's own credential — the object-capability layer DTG does not model. Register it as an Archon schema DID (createSchema); minted AACs reference it via credentialSchema. Trust-graph credentials (VRC/VPC/VEC/VWC/VMC) reference DTG's schemas instead.

id.description: The credential's own DID (the asset it is anchored as).

issuer.description: The issuing controller DID (a party to the referenced relationship).

id.description: The agent DID (the holder proves control of its key).

relationship.description: The DTG VRC establishing controller ↔ agent (root only).

proof.description: Optional inner signature. An op-log-as-proof AAC omits it — authenticity is that its asset is controlled by the issuer (docs/keymaster-account.md).

delegable.description: Advisory only — not a delegation gate (Karp; docs/delegation-chain.md §5).

parent.description: The parent capability this one narrows (delegations); null at the root.
